verdict.rationale: The API reference is published under a release-versioned docs path (v1.15.23) covering /kickoff, /status and /resume. CrewAI also documents one concrete deprecation practice: older CLI commands keep working but print a deprecation warning. There is no stated deprecation policy, timeline or API-versioning scheme, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: an explicit documented deprecation policy with timelines, an explicit API versioning scheme or version-pinned endpoints, deprecation handling for the Python/REST APIs rather than just CLI commands, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: These older commands still work but print a yellow deprecation warning.
